scope: Second 40-institution private-nonprofit discovery batch across California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia, Florida, and Georgia
safeguards: Only official institution-owned employee pages or institution-specific ATS tenants were promoted.
Student and alumni career services were not treated as employee vacancy sources.
Shared-system boards were held when the institution or campus could not be durably scoped.
Merged, renamed, and apparently inactive institutions were held rather than attributed to a successor board.
